proposed_fixes.title: visibility-preserving active-monitor positioning
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a classified root window becomes a child before asynchronous placement and inherited invisibility is converted into explicit SW_HIDE.
plan: Trace root/child/styles immediately before active-monitor placement using the default Flutter app.
Revalidate eligible root HWNDs at the actual move boundary and preserve show/hide state when positioning.
Add hidden-root, reparented child and ordinary visible window tests; preserve activation/minimized/maximized behavior.
verification: Flutter render child retains visibility and renders with cursor on the secondary monitor.
Application-owned hidden windows are not re-shown; ordinary active-monitor moves still work.
